title: MongoDB Operator Injection on Login
learning_objectives: Recognise NoSQL operator injection when a request body is forwarded verbatim into a Mongo filter
Bypass authentication with operator objects like {"$ne": null} instead of scalar values
Turn a login endpoint into a blind oracle and extract a secret field with $regex prefix probes
Explain why casting/validating query shapes at the trust boundary defeats this class of bug
flag_hint: Bypass /login with $ne, then blind-extract admin.reset_token (64 hex) via a $regex login oracle and POST /solve {"token":"<64hex>"} to receive the flag read from $FLAG_PATH.
inspired_by: OWASP NoSQL injection guide and the classic HackTheBox 'MarketDump' operator-injection pattern
